meta.name: baoyu-youtube-transcript
meta.description: Downloads YouTube video transcripts/subtitles and cover images by URL or video ID. Supports multiple languages, translation, chapters, and speaker identification. Caches raw data for fast re-formatting. Use when user asks to "get YouTube transcript", "download subtitles", "get captions", "YouTube字幕", "YouTube封面", "视频封面", "video thumbnail", "video cover image", or provides a YouTube URL and wants the transcript/subtitle text or cover image extracted.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 下载YouTube视频字幕和封面图片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从YouTube视频获取字幕或封面图片
copy.tagline_en: Download YouTube video transcripts and cover images
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to get subtitles or cover images from YouTube videos

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据 YouTube 视频链接或 ID 下载字幕、封面图，支持多语言、翻译、章节分段和说话人识别，并缓存数据以便快速重新格式化。
howto.when: 当用户要求“获取 YouTube 字幕”、“下载字幕”、“YouTube 封面”等，或直接提供 YouTube 链接并希望提取字幕或封面时触发。

say.text: 帮我下载这个视频的字幕：https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ
给我这个视频的封面图：https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ
say.note: Claude 会下载视频封面并返回。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can download YouTube video transcripts/subtitles and cover images by URL or video ID. It supports multiple languages, translation, chapters, and speaker identification, and caches raw data for fast re-formatting.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to "get YouTube transcript", "download subtitles", "get captions", "YouTube cover", etc., or provides a YouTube URL and wants the transcript or cover image extracted.

say_en.text: Download the transcript for this video: https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the default English transcript in Markdown.

say_en.text: Get Chinese subtitles and translate to English: https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ
say_en.note: Claude will download Chinese subtitles then translate to English.

say_en.text: Get the cover image for this video: https://youtu.be/dQw4w9WgXcQ
say_en.note: Claude will download the video thumbnail.
